errors.text: The proposed 10–20 h milling duration substantially exceeds the target 1–6 h window and may change the phase evolution or promote contamination rather than reconstruct the reported process.

The claimed displacement rate below 10 nm/s, sintering strain-rate window of 10^-2 to 10^-1 s^-1, and heating/cooling rate above 100°C/min are unsupported and do not match the target SPS heating rate of 50°C/min.
The falsification experiment cannot distinguish grain-boundary strengthening from solute strengthening: a single hardness value provides no causal separation between these mechanisms.
The specified 500 g Vickers load is approximately 4.9 N, whereas the target test uses 0.05 kN, approximately 50 N; this is a tenfold load mismatch.
Predicted ductility above 10% conflicts with the target outcome of high strength but limited ductility and intergranular fracture.
